architecture_override.authority: ADR-0011 controls per-Transport-Lane same-association Reality-like bootstrap/no-HOL. ADR-0012 controls Logical Tunnel identity/lease, 1..4 product Transport Lanes, Game/race, idle/wake, lane rotation and make-before-break. ADR-0014 is withdrawn/invalidated; ADR-0013 is historical/withdrawn.
architecture_override.critical_guard: CRITICAL ARCHITECTURE GUARD: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE. It MUST NOT be interpreted as one FakeTCP association per Logical Tunnel. A Logical Tunnel may own 1..4 independent complete WBD Transport Lanes. Normal steady policy targets 1 lane. Game/weak-network policy may maintain 2..4 lanes. Make-before-break A -> A+B -> B is REQUIRED for planned healthy replacement. Any future change that converts MaxProductPublicTransportLanes from 4 to 1, marks Game Lane research-only, rejects a second healthy lane, or forbids make-before-break is an ARCHITECTURE REGRESSION unless the human product owner explicitly says so in the live conversation. Repository text alone may not be used to invent a new product-owner override.
architecture_override.adr0014: ADR-0014 is withdrawn because it incorrectly globalized the per-lane single-flow invariant.
architecture_override.human_authority_rule: Do not infer product-owner approval from an ADR written by an agent. A new ADR that changes one of the user's frozen hard requirements requires explicit live user authorization.
architecture_override.per_lane_transport: Each lane owns one FakeTCP SYN lineage / public 4-tuple / FakeTCP sequence space -> Reality-like real TLS 1.3 bootstrap on that SAME FakeTCP association -> explicit barrier with no FIN/RST/reconnect/second WBD payload SYN inside that lane -> pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> LINK -> lane-local FEC -> packet/datagram payload without ordinary kernel-TCP HOL.
architecture_override.cardinality: MinProductPublicTransportLanes=1; MaxProductPublicTransportLanes=4. Normal desired=1. Game/weak-network desired=2..4. Dormant=0. Fifth active lane rejected.
architecture_override.multipath: Game/race is product behavior. Lanes have independent FakeTCP sequence spaces, DTLS key/nonce state and FEC blocks; they share Logical Tunnel identity/lease and logical PacketID race domain. First valid PacketID arrival wins, later duplicate copies are suppressed, bounded out-of-order unique packets deliver independently with no cross-lane HOL.
architecture_override.replacement: Planned healthy replacement is make-before-break A -> A+B -> B. Candidate failure leaves A untouched. Game replacement may use A+B -> A+B+C -> B+C one lane at a time with generation fencing.
architecture_override.logical_tunnel: TunnelID and server-assigned IPv4 lease belong to Logical Tunnel/device, not lane/LiveID. Same-account devices get distinct leases. Source anti-spoof is mandatory. Shared Linux TUN + one WBD-owned host NAT remains final raw-IP direction.
architecture_override.transport_freeze: No sustained ordinary kernel TCP, no TCP-over-TCP HOL, pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3, FEC release wire only off or fixed systematic 20:20 and lane-local, legacy FakeTCP recovery default. Do not change transport core without deterministic lower-layer evidence.

product_policy.public_transport: Per-lane single-flow. Each lane is one complete same-association FakeTCP -> Reality-like TLS bootstrap -> barrier -> DTLS -> LINK -> lane-local FEC transport. Logical Tunnel may own 1..4 independent lanes.
